authorization_contract: query /index/index/apiface by UDID before consulting any locally saved card
treat code=1 + msg=ok + expire>now as an active UDID authorization, matching the legacy BSPHPy flow
active UDID authorization skips the card prompt and continues to Runtime Config + Verify
Verify is responsible for returning access_level and permissions and for current-App applicability
missing or expired active authorization opens the card prompt
network/server/unknown payloads are not treated as an unactivated UDID
first activation keeps the before-/appstore-/after authorization state-change gate
device_verification_required: fresh App + previously activated UDID does not show card prompt
fresh App + active UDID proceeds to Verify and consumes server access_level/permissions
UDID with no activation record shows card prompt
expired UDID authorization shows replacement-card prompt
new card activation still passes before-/appstore-/after state-change gate
App mismatch returns to the same card prompt
secret_storage_policy: test/real Verify Secret is injected only into the controlled final artifact and is not committed to public Git history
